lines.text: A hardening in part has come to Israel until the Gentiles' full number comes in, and so all Israel will be saved.
The Deliverer will come from Sinai and remove godlessness from Jacob, taking away their sins in God's covenant.
The Gentiles received mercy through Israel's disobedience, and God consigned everyone to disobedience to have mercy on everyone.
The depth of God's wisdom and knowledge is praised, for from Him and through Him and to Him are all things.
